title: Switchblade Comb I Unboxing and Product Review #switchbladecomb #stilettocomb #knifecomb #comb
description:
In this video I unbox and review a switchblade comb I bought on amazon.
You can also define this knife as a stiletto comb or a knife comb.
Overall, I think it’s a high quality comb that has been made with premium materials, such as stainless steel and industrial grade plastic.

If you would like to also have this amazing switchblade comb you can find it on amazon here: https://www.amazon.de/-/en/Stainless-Steel-Pocket-Folding-Hairstyling/dp/B07BFTLKVP/ref=sr_1_3?dchild=1&keywords=stiletto+kamm&qid=1614965929&sr=8-3
